parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action specified in the rule. Valid values:

- **1**: alert

- **2**: block

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description:
The ID of the rule.

> You can call the [ListContainerDefenseRule](~~2590599~~) operation to query the IDs of rules.

parameters.name: RuleSwitch
parameters.description:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

- **1**: enabled

- **0**: disabled

parameters.name: RuleType
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

- 1: system rule

- 2: custom rule

parameters.name: Scope
parameters.description: The effective scope of the rule.

sub_parameters.name: AllNamespace
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to include all namespaces. Valid values:

- **0**: no

- **1**: yes

sub_parameters.name: ClusterId
sub_parameters.description:
The ID of the cluster on which the rule takes effect.

> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters.
